# Aviato

Aviato provides native-BYOK company and person intelligence, including search, enrichment, relationships, investments, vesting data, exports, image access, market maps, location lookup, credit checks, and contact discovery.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/aviato/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Enrich Companies** (read-only): Enrich one to 100 companies in one request.
- **Bulk Enrich People** (read-only): Enrich one to 20 people in one request.
- **Bulk Reveal Person Emails** (read-only): Reveal stored email records for one to 100 people.
- **Enrich Company** (read-only): Look up one company's general profile, including identity, URLs, industries, headcount, products, jobs, and available relationship data.
- **Enrich Company Financials** (read-only): Get a company's financial information, including funding, market data, and estimated annual revenue.
- **Enrich Company Legal Data** (read-only): Get a company's legal identifiers and registered name.
- **Enrich Company Social Metrics** (read-only): Get a company's social audience counts, history, and growth metrics.
- **Enrich Company Web Traffic** (read-only): Get a company's web traffic history, sources, and visitor geography.
- **Enrich Person** (read-only): Look up one person by a supported identifier.
- **Filter People** (read-only): Filter people with predefined profile, location, education, and employment fields, one page at a time.
- **Generate Market Map**: Start asynchronous generation of a similar-company market map.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected Aviato team's current credit balance and, when available, its balance immediately after the latest top-up.
- **Get Export Chunk Download URL**: Mint a short-lived presigned URL for exactly one Aviato export chunk without fetching it.
- **Get Export Download URLs**: Mint one short-lived presigned URL per matching chunk in an Aviato export without fetching any URL.
- **Get Image Token**: Generate a token for loading company or person images from Aviato's image servers.
- **Get Market Map** (read-only): Poll one supplied Aviato market map ID once.
- **Get Person Contact Info** (read-only): Call Aviato's generic contact-info compatibility endpoint for one person's stored email records.
- **Get Person Email Hashes** (read-only): Return SHA-256 hashes of one person's personal email addresses for matching.
- **List Company Acquisitions** (read-only): Return one page of companies acquired by a company.
- **List Company Employees** (read-only): Return one page of employees and work history for a company.
- **List Company Founders** (read-only): Return one page of a company's founders.
- **List Company Fund Investments** (read-only): Return one page of investment fund vehicles in which a company invested, including available company and person investor relationships.
- **List Company Funding Rounds** (read-only): Return one page of a company's equity financing rounds and their company or person investors.
- **List Company Inbound Investments** (read-only): Return one page of investments made into a company, including available company or person investor details.
- **List Company Outbound Investments** (read-only): Return one page of investments a company made into other companies.
- **List Company Raised Funds** (read-only): Return one page of named investment fund vehicles raised by a company, with amount, date, and available company or person investors.
- **List Export Chunks** (read-only): List all chunk names in one Aviato export, optionally filtered by team, table, or deletion state.
- **List Exports** (read-only): List all data-export metadata available to the connected Aviato account or selected team.
- **List Person Company Investments** (read-only): Return one page of companies in which a person invested, with documented investment details.
- **List Person Founded Companies** (read-only): Return one page of companies founded by a person.
- **List Person Fund Investments** (read-only): Return one page of funds in which a person invested.
- **List Person Vestings** (read-only): Return one page of a person's vesting records.
- **Reveal Person Emails** (read-only): Use Aviato's explicit email endpoint to reveal stored email records for one person, optionally filtered by personal, work, or student…
- **Reveal Person Phones** (read-only): Reveal stored phone records for one person.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search companies with Aviato's JSON DSL and return one bounded page.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Find Aviato geocoded location IDs for company or person search filters.
- **Search People** (read-only): Search people with Aviato's JSON DSL and return one bounded page.
